entries.text: I hear you beat Grusha and earned yourself a\nGym Badge! Way to go!
entries.label: sub_006_trainer_01

entries.text: Now don’t you worry—you’re still free to enjoy\nthe snowy slopes here on Glaseado Mountain\r\neven now that you’ve beaten the Gym.
entries.label: sub_006_trainer_02

entries.text: Want to try your hand at the Snow Slope Run?
entries.label: sub_006_trainer_03

entries.text: Which course will you go for?
entries.label: sub_006_trainer_04

entries.text: The Powder Snow Course it is! Have yourself an\neasy-breezy slide down the mountain!
entries.label: sub_006_trainer_05

entries.text: The Blizzard Course! Copy that! Try to keep your\nfocus sharp all the way down!
entries.label: sub_006_trainer_06

entries.text: The Sheer Cold Course, eh? Quite a challenge,\nto be sure! Good luck out there, kid!
entries.label: sub_006_trainer_07

entries.text: You’ll need to ride a Pokémon down one of\nGlaseado Mountain’s natural snowy slopes...\r\nThat’s all there is to it!
entries.label: sub_006_trainer_08

entries.text: Choose one of three possible courses and reach\nits finish line within the target time, and you\r\nmight just earn yourself a nice prize!
entries.label: sub_006_trainer_09

entries.text: Have fun, give it your all, and see if you can\nkeep beating your personal bests!
entries.label: sub_006_trainer_10

entries.text: Your best times, eh? Let’s see...
entries.label: sub_006_trainer_11

entries.text: That’d be [VAR 0x0201(0000)]:[VAR 0x0201(0001)].[VAR 0x0201(0002)] on the Powder Snow Course.
entries.label: sub_006_trainer_12

entries.text: As for the Blizzard Course, your best time is\n[VAR 0x0201(0000)]:[VAR 0x0201(0001)].[VAR 0x0201(0002)]!
entries.label: sub_006_trainer_13

entries.text: And for the Sheer Cold Course, your best time is\n[VAR 0x0201(0000)]:[VAR 0x0201(0001)].[VAR 0x0201(0002)]!
entries.label: sub_006_trainer_14

entries.text: Hmm... You haven’t reached the goal on the\nPowder Snow Course yet.
entries.label: sub_006_trainer_15

entries.text: As for the Blizzard Course, you still need to\ncomplete that one.
entries.label: sub_006_trainer_16

entries.text: And for the Sheer Cold Course? Yeah, you need\nto reach the goal before you can get a best time!
entries.label: sub_006_trainer_17

entries.text: Yeah! I’m ready to go!
entries.label: sub_006_select_01

entries.text: What are the rules?

entries.text: Well done on your first time completing the\nPowder Snow Course! Here—this prize is for you!
entries.label: sub_006_trainer_18

entries.text: From now on, you’ll be able to take on the\nBlizzard Course when you feel up to it!\c\nCareful though—it’s pretty tough!
entries.label: sub_006_trainer_24

entries.text: You completed a full run on the Blizzard Course\nfor the first time! Now you’re practically a pro!\r\nHere—this prize is for you!
entries.label: sub_006_trainer_19

entries.text: From now on, you’ll be able to take on the\nSheer Cold Course—our toughest slope of all!\r\nCome back and give it a go if you dare!
entries.label: sub_006_trainer_25

entries.text: You completed the Sheer Cold Course for the\nfirst time! You’re a snow-slope master now!\r\nHere, take this prize. You’ve earned it!
entries.label: sub_006_trainer_20

entries.text: Congratulations! You beat your previous best\ntime with those amazing sliding skills!\c\nHere’s your reward for a run well-done!
entries.label: sub_006_trainer_21

entries.text: Nice job reaching the goal safe and sound.\nCan’t wait to see you do even better next time!\r\nFor now, here’s a reward for your fine efforts.
entries.label: sub_006_trainer_22
